# ONEUL — Full Reference

## Company

- Name: ONEUL Inc.
- Korean legal name: 주식회사 오엔이유엘
- Type: Software company
- Country: South Korea
- Brand message: Life ON, ONEUL
- Secondary message (Korean): 오늘을 자각하다. ("Be aware of today.")

ONEUL Inc. is a Korean software company building digital products that help
people live each day more intentionally. The name ONEUL comes from the Korean
word "오늘" (oneul), meaning "today". The "ON" in ONEUL is also read as a
switch turning on — turning your life ON.

ONEUL believes there are many tools for planning the future, but not enough
tools for living today well. Instead of building large platforms, ONEUL builds
small products that solve clear problems and help users organize their lives
and act with intention.

## How we work — three principles

1. Respect — Respect each other, always. Everyone is an equal colleague
   regardless of role or seniority; opinions are shared freely, feedback is
   honest, and courtesy toward people is never dropped.
2. Execution — Show what is good for users by building it. Good ideas are
   proven with real products and results, not with talk or documents: build
   small, use it, fix it fast.
3. Integrity — Do what is right, not what is easy. When the easy path and the
   right path diverge, ONEUL chooses the one that matches its philosophy and
   genuinely helps users' days, over short-term metrics.

## Products

### MyDay (마이데이)

MyDay is an iOS daily planning app by ONEUL designed around morning planning,
daily focus, and evening reflection. Tagline: "Awake & Aware".

Core concept: focus only on today. Unlike conventional todo apps that keep
accumulating future tasks, MyDay works in single-day units.

Daily cycle:
1. Morning — Plan your day: gather today's tasks from calendars, reminders,
   or direct input.
2. Day — Focus on today: select the most important tasks as "Must Do" to make
   the day's priorities clear.
3. Evening — Reflect on your day, leading to a better tomorrow.

- Official website: https://myday.now
- Platform: iOS
- Category: Productivity / daily planning / intentional living

## Site structure

Languages: Korean (ko), English (en), Japanese (ja), Simplified Chinese (zh),
Traditional Chinese (zh-tw). All company pages are prefixed with the locale
(/ko, /en, /ja, /zh, /zh-tw). The entry page picks the language from the
visitor's time zone (Korea → ko, Japan → ja, mainland China → zh, Taiwan /
Hong Kong / Macau → zh-tw, everywhere else → en); visitors can switch
languages in the site header and the choice is remembered.

- / — Entry page: choose the company website (/{locale}/main) or the product website (https://myday.now)
- /{locale}/main — Home: brand, company definition, philosophy, products, manifesto
- /{locale}/about — About ONEUL and its philosophy
- /{locale}/products — Product list
- /{locale}/products/myday — MyDay overview and link to https://myday.now
- /{locale}/privacy — Privacy policy
- /{locale}/terms — Terms
